facts.text: The resort is set in Andalusia between Marbella, Benahavis and Estepona in the south of Spain.
facts.excerpt: assumes a picturesque setting in Andalusia, between Marbella, Benahavís and Estepona in the south of Spain

facts.text: The resort is in the Golf Valley and is accessible from Malaga Airport.
facts.excerpt: The resort’s location in the Golf Valley is conveniently accessible from Málaga Airport and Marbella’s transport hubs.

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by three golf courses.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by three golf courses

facts.text: The grounds include a lake, a Roman amphitheatre and more than 1,200 original works of art.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by three golf courses, a tranquil lake, Roman amphitheatre and more than 1,200 original works of art

facts.text: The resort has a private racquet club and a thermal spa.
facts.excerpt: with a private racquet club and thermal spa

facts.text: The resort has a beach club serving fresh seafood.
facts.excerpt: Dine on Andalusian haute cuisine or fresh seafood at the beach club.

facts.text: The By The Sea Beach Club serves paellas, local espetos and cocktails with a view of the Mediterranean sunset.
facts.excerpt: the By The Sea Beach Club is great for paellas, the local espetos and the perfect cocktail to enjoy while you view the Mediterranean sunset

facts.text: The Loggia offers a quiet dinner atmosphere and the Pergola serves snacks by the pool.
facts.excerpt: The Loggia, with its special décor, offers a quiet dinner atmosphere, the Pergola is great for a snack by the pool

facts.text: The villas have a private pool and terrace with one or two bedrooms.
facts.excerpt: Live the Mediterranean dream of a private pool villa. Terracotta, marble statues and views of the amphitheatre transport you to a golden era.

facts.text: Rooms are set around central courtyards.
facts.excerpt: rooms are dotted around central courtyards and feature elegant décor and soothing tones

facts.text: Villa accommodation has hosted First Lady Michelle Obama.
facts.excerpt: Hosted First Lady Michelle Obama

facts.text: The property was once a stately home belonging to the Count of Villa Padierna.
facts.excerpt: Once a stately home belonging to the Count of Villa Padierna

facts.text: The building is ochre-pink and its interior is filled with paintings, sculptures and tapestries.
facts.excerpt: from the striking ochre-pink building to the splendid interior filled with paintings, sculptures and tapestries

facts.text: The Roman spa offers hydrotherapy, hammam and aromatherapy rooms.
facts.excerpt: Its enormous Roman spa offers sensational hydrotherapy, hammam, aromatherapy rooms, and more

facts.text: The resort is about a half-hour drive from the center.
facts.excerpt: It may be a half-hour drive from the center

facts.text: The resort is close to Saladillo beach and 12 km from Puerto Banus.
facts.excerpt: It is close to Saladillo beach and 12 km from the Puerto Banús stores and acclaimed marina.

facts.text: Parking is available for an additional daily fee.
facts.excerpt: This service is available for an additional daily fee.

facts.text: The resort has 6 meeting rooms and an amphitheater.
facts.excerpt: Yes, there are 6 meeting rooms and an amphitheater.

facts.text: There are 10 restaurant concepts during high season.
facts.excerpt: you will find 10 restaurant concepts (during high season)

facts.text: Connecting and family rooms are available.
facts.excerpt: Connecting and familiy rooms available

facts.text: Rooms are elegant with soothing tones.
facts.excerpt: feature elegant décor and soothing tones
